media.alt: AKU briefs HEC on academic plans
AKU briefs HEC on academic plans

content.text: "A three-member team from the Higher Education Commission visited the Aga Khan University at its Stadium Road campus on March 28, 2016, to discuss matters of mutual interest.

The HEC team included the Chairman Professor Mukhtar Ahmed, DG Accreditation and Attestation, Muhammad Raza Chohan, and HEC Regional Centre, Karachi, Director, Sulaiman Ahmad. They were received by AKU's President Firoz Rasul and members of the academic and administrative leadership team.
The visit started with a tour of the Stadium Road campus which has expanded significantly in the last decade with new academic and healthcare buildings and facilities.

The first stop was the Faculty of Health Sciences Library that provides users with unprecedented access to information and knowledge. The library resources include 12 HEC-supported databases, 8,000 full-text online journals as well as resources in the 10 libraries on AKU's other campuses in East Africa and the United Kingdom. The library spends Rs 40 million annually on library collection books and journals.

After touring the Medical College and School of Nursing and Midwifery, the group visited the University's latest teaching and learning facility, the Centre for Innovation in Medical Education. Pakistan's first advanced medical simulation centre, CIME is open to undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate students as well as working healthcare professionals. Besides modern teaching spaces, the CIME also houses e-health facilities that allow a select number of clinics to be held between Karachi and Gilgit and Afghanistan.
The group also visited the Sports Centre which has high quality recreational facilities for students and viewed a model of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences to be built in Education City, Karachi.

The tour was followed by a detailed briefing about the University's current programmes and future academic plans, HEC funded research projects, the inclusion of blended learning - face-to-face and online modules - in AKU's offerings, and avenues for future collaboration all came under discussion.
At the end of the visit, President Firoz Rasul thanked HEC and particularly Professor Mukhtar Ahmed for the continuous support and encouragement provided by the Commission to AKU."
